lessons.title: Lesson 1 — I like, I want

lessons.words: ขอ khɔ̌ɔ to ask for, request, may i... [request permission] ได้ dâai to get, receive, obtain, [past tense/completion marker], can, able to มี mii to have, there is, there are เอา ao to take, get, want, bring, have [sex] ให้ hâi to give, for, let, allow, make [causative] จาน jaan plate, dish, classifier for plates, classifier for plates of food ใบ bai leaf, sheet, ใบขับขี่ driver's license;ใบเสร็จ receipt; [classifier for containers, sheets, tickets, fruit]; mute ตัว dtua body, self, figure, character, [main classifier for animals, clothing, furniture, etc.], self [reflexive] อัน an that which, [general classifier for small items], piece, item, danger [อันตราย] ชิ้น chín piece, classifier for pieces of food/cake เท่าไหร่ tâo-rài how much เงิน ngoen money, silver ถูก thùuk cheap, correct, right, [passive voice marker] to be x-ed ร้าน ráan shop, store, [classifier for shops]

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — People and family
